items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Who was the leader of the Pacific Band? At that, at the time I know- Joel Lizard.

ctx.x: They'd been playing that long, yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Maybe longer than that. Who was the leader of the Pacific Band? At that, at the time I know- Joel Lizard. Joel Lizard. Joel Lizard. Yeah, Joel Lizard.
Joel Lizard. No, no, no, Joel Lizard.
